goal: Give Orchestrator a 5th phase file, orchestrate.jsonl, owned exclusively by the orchestrator role, so plan.jsonl becomes purely Planner's file.
name_rationale: Matches the plan/make/check/reflect naming pattern — each file named after its owning skill's verb.

steps.action: add 'orchestrate' to New-Trail.ps1's phase list and its reported files array
update schema.trail-frame.asset.json's $comment with the role-to-file map
update pmcro-trail's command/run asset docs (files list, skeleton description)
update pmcro-orchestrator's run.orchestrate.asset.md to point its own frame at orchestrate.jsonl instead of plan.jsonl
re-run New-Trail.ps1 for real to prove orchestrate.jsonl now appears; use that trail to log this very change

success_criteria: every doc referencing the 4-file shape updated to the 5-file shape
